results.title: France deploys thousands of police as Paris march is restricted to city’s edge
results.description: PARIS (AP) — Paris braced for a fresh march by students and workers over school funding and soaring living costs Saturday, one week after violent unrest left shops looted and cars burned. The new march was restricted to the city’s southeastern edge, away from the center, as police deployed in force across France.

results.description: A loudspeaker announcement that a portion of the Chorbagan puja pandal was collapsing allegedly sparked panic among revellers, triggering a stampede-like situation.

results.title: Arshdeep Singh sets India record for most wickets in a year
results.description: Christchurch: India left-arm star bowler Arshdeep Singh achieved a significant milestone during the second T20I against New Zealand at the Hagley Oval here Saturday as he became India’s leading wicket-taker in T20Is in a calendar year. Arshdeep took 2-33 in the second match to achieve the feat as he now has 38 wickets in 2026. […]

results.title: Shooting in France ahead of nationwide demonstrations, one dead; Four injured including a 12 year old girl
results.description: The shootings in Trappes and La Verrière near Paris have come ahead of nationwide demonstrations in France. One person was killed in the firing by the car-borne attacker, while four people, including a 12-year-old girl, were injured. The police have arrested the suspect. The National Anti-Terrorism Agency is investigating the case from racial, religious and possible terrorist angles.

results.title: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Pro gets 41% discount on Flipkart: Check price, bank offers and more
results.description: The Samsung Galaxy Book4 Pro is available at Rs 89,990 on Flipkart, down from its listed price of Rs 1,51,789. This translates to a discount of Rs 61,799, or around 41%, on the laptop. Buyers can also avail of an additional Rs 8,000 discount through an eligible HDFC Bank card offer, bringing the effective price down further.
